# References

The pages are synthetic and do not copy a particular supplier's branding. Their fields and relationships follow common business-document conventions.

- **Purchase orders and amendments:** OASIS Universal Business Language (UBL) 2.3, `Order` and `OrderChange` document models. <https://docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/os-UBL-2.3/UBL-2.3.html>
- **Goods receipt notes:** OASIS UBL 2.3 `ReceiptAdvice` document model, including received quantities and references to orders. <https://docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/os-UBL-2.3/UBL-2.3.html>
- **Supplier and split invoices:** OASIS UBL 2.3 `Invoice` model, with invoice lines and order references. The split billing example is represented as a second invoice linked to the same PO. <https://docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/os-UBL-2.3/UBL-2.3.html>
- **Commercial process cross-check:** SAP Business Accelerator Hub documentation for purchase-order and supplier-invoice APIs describes the standard order/invoice entities used in ERP workflows. <https://api.sap.com/> (search for `Purchase Order` and `Supplier Invoice`).

The generator uses fictional company names, addresses, and identifiers. References support document structure and terminology; they are not claimed as exact visual templates.
